items.source: The default implementation for PropertySourceFactory, wrapping every resource in a ResourcePropertySource.
items.translation: `PropertySourceFactory` 接口的默认实现将每个资源包装在 `ResourcePropertySource` 中。

items.source: Returns the value of the propertySourceFactory record component.
items.translation: 返回 `propertySourceFactory` 记录组件的值。

items.source: Uses of PropertySourceFactory in org.springframework.core.io.support
items.translation: `org.springframework.core.io.support` 包中 `PropertySourceFactory` 的用法

items.source: Creates an instance of a PropertySourceDescriptor record class.
items.translation: 创建 `PropertySourceDescriptor` 记录类的实例。

items.source: Support classes for Spring's resource abstraction.
items.translation: 支持 Spring 资源抽象的支持类。
